Name: Seasonal Portraits For Sam That Keep His Dumb Mullet
Author: sneakyham
Description:
Credits to ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Poltergeister's Season Outfits[/url] as I used their portraits and sprites for Sam as a base - the Work and Flower Dance portraits specifically having no changes other than an edit to the hair, and referenced their code heavily when trying to make this as I had no idea what I was doing.

Mod currently includes 7 new outfits with Fall being his fall outfit and an edit to his beach hair.

4 Seasonal:
Spring (Flower Dance Base)
Summer (Summer Edit)
Fall (Minor Fall Edit)
Winter Indoor (Fall Edit)
Winter Outdoor (Fall Edit)

2 Festival:
Spirit's Eve (Beach Edit)
Flower Dance (Minor Flower Dance Edit)

And one outfit for him being at work (Also Minor Work Edit)

[size=4][b][u]UPDATE:[/u][/b][/size]
With 1.6 releasing winter outfits, I've updated this mod to allow for the option of using those portraits instead. The vanilla version will keep his hat, while having the IndoorOutdoor version will have him remove his hat inside so you can keep his horrible hair out all you want. The default option just continues using the same portraits and sprites that were originally made for this mod.
